programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.desc: Four cheese-obsessed chefs go head-to-head in two challenges; Guy Fieri rolls a cheese die to determine how many different types of cheese the chefs must use before they shop the sample tables for their cheesy winner's dinner.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.desc: Guy Fieri invites four burger meisters who think outside of the bun to pound out four heavy-hitting burgers using six pounds of ingredients; they slide sliders to select the unusual ingredient they must add to both their cheeseburger and side.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.desc: Guy Fieri gives an unfiltered behind-the-scenes view of the Flavortown Market experience; from the chefs' arrival in the market tour and Guy's pre-show pep talk -- all will be revealed for the first time.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.desc: Four chefs with a knack for cooking on a budget take on two of Guy Fieri's all-new budget games; the chefs must make a hearty lunch with ingredients that satisfy Guy's price-based grocery list.

programs.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programs.desc: Guy Fieri challenges the chefs to a fish-filled food fight as the reigning champ casts their net for more riches against Cristina Topham and Lambert Givens; Judges Jonathon Sawyer and Michael Voltaggio decide who is the winner of this maritime madness.

programs.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programs.desc: Guy Fieri fires up a full-throttle meat lovers showdown as the returning champ battles Quentin Garcia and Dominique Leach in making bold, protein-packed plates; Maneet Chauhan and Michael Voltaggio judge who has enough sizzle to take home up to $20,000.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.desc: The winners of the first two City Food Fights face off to prove their city's culinary supremacy; Guy Fieri sets up games inspired by their city's basketball teams; the winning team takes home $15,000 and the GGG City Food Fight champion trophy!
